items.body:
### Summary

This is a duplicate of bug #85020, which is closed and has been locked already, but I have just reproduced the problem with Ansible 2.19 and Ansible 2.20. IOW, it seems that the fix didn't make it into the code base, and indeed, if I look into the Ansible code in my virtualenv, there's no space.

I am running Ansible from a virtualenv on a Debian 13 machine.

### Issue Type

Bug Report

### Component Name

ansible-galaxy

### Ansible Version

```console
$ ansible --version

ansible-galaxy [core 2.20.1]
  config file = None
  configured module search path = ['/home/user/.ansible/plugins/modules', '/usr/share/ansible/plugins/modules']
  ansible python module location = /home/user/ansible/.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/ansible
  ansible collection location = /home/user/.ansible/collections:/usr/share/ansible/collections
  executable location = /home/user/ansible/.venv/bin/ansible-galaxy
  python version = 3.13.5 (main, Jun 12 2025, 12:40:22) [Clang 20.1.4 ] (/home/user/ansible/.venv/bin/python3)
  jinja version = 3.1.6
  pyyaml version = 6.0.3 (with libyaml v0.2.5)
```

### Configuration

```console
# if using a version older than ansible-core 2.12 you should omit the '-t all'
$ ansible-config dump --only-changed -t all
CONFIG_FILE() = /home/user/ansible/ansible.cfg
DEFAULT_GATHERING(/home/user/ansible/ansible.cfg) = smart
DEFAULT_ROLES_PATH(/home/user/ansible/ansible.cfg) = ['/home/user/ONSA/ansible/roles', '/home/user/my-ansible-roles', '/home/user/ansible-shared-roles']
EDITOR(env: EDITOR) = /bin/vim
INVENTORY_ENABLED(/home/user/ansible/ansible.cfg) = ['ini', 'host_list', 'script', 'yaml', 'auto']
PAGER(env: PAGER) = less

GALAXY_SERVERS:


CONNECTION:
==========

ssh:
___
ssh_args(/home/user/ansible/ansible.cfg) = -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new
```

### OS / Environment

Debian 13

### Steps to Reproduce

<!--- Paste example playbooks or commands between quotes below -->
```shell
(venv)$ ansible-galaxy init blabla
(venv)$ cat blabla/defaults/main.yml
#SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT-0
---
# defaults file for blabla
```


### Expected Results

```shell
(venv)$ ansible-galaxy init blabla
(venv)$ cat blabla/defaults/main.yml
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT-0
---
# defaults file for blabla
```

### Actual Results

```console
The problem occurs on generating the skeleton for a new role, not while running the role. But the upshot is that this creates an annoying warning that can't be easily suppressed with

# yamllint disable-line rule:require-starting-space

on the line that would separate the yamllint comment from the actual license spec. Only if I remove the leading '#', the rule will trigger and remove the warning.
```
